blocks.text: INN NEWS - Presidential elections in 2024 are getting closer. Some political parties have declared presidential candidates. After NasDem and his unconfirmed coalition put on the netizens of DKI Jakarta, Anies Baswandan, the Treasury just declared their capres.
The Ummat Party at the closing of the national work meeting (Rakernas) I in Jakarta, Wednesday 15 February 2023, also declared Anies as Capres 2024.
It was delivered directly by the head of the Sistro Assembly of the Ammien Rais Ummat Party. "So, just now about the president, it's called Anies Baswedan himself," said Amien.
Amien announced it along with the Chairman of the Ridho Rahmadi Ball that was also on stage.

It's been known that the Capres of the Ummat Party's choice since 2017 have been purchased as father of Indonesian identity politics because it plays in a real political practice with its co-governors (Pilgub) DKI Jakarta versus Basuki Tjahaja Purnama aka Ahok.
The Indonesian political label of the identity father to Anies is now in line with the Ummat Party who publicly delivered its party's political identity.
Chairman of the Ummat Party, Ridho Rahmadi, delivered his party to political identity. At first he said his party would fight empty political narratives and mislead in a way that was and elegant.

"The Ummat Party will specifically fight in a civilized and elegant way, the empty and misleading, political narrative of identity. We're going to aloud say, 'Yes, we are the Ummat Party, and we are identity politics', 'Ridho said while opening a national meeting at the Animal Party's premiere in Haji House, East Jakarta, not long ago.

Declaration of Anies as the Capres of the Ummat Party that carries identity politics, as if reliving the game in 2017 with some of the same characters. They begin the reunion and will unleash power everywhere.
Meanwhile, political elite, until President Joko Widodo (Jokowi) has asked me not to use identity politics in elections.
The women, in case they also go to the heat of political tension at the election (Pilgub) DKI Jakarta 2017 and the election of the President 2019.
With the presence of public trauma, the political terminology of identity becomes a very avoided term, especially by political elite to the general public.

Especially now that society can easily see the track record of someone who plays dirty politics by exploiting certain religions and identities through mass media. So that they would be more observant to choose a leader who could advance Indonesia through diversity rather than utilize identity politics.
While future leaders who play politics identity will only be selected by anti-nationalism, pancasila, and Bhineka Single Ika.
Then is it with the Ummat Party preparing his way to suicide in the beginning of a fight?
